Please try again.'); } setFlights(data.flights || []); setSearched(true); if (data.demo) { setError('Sample flight results — live airline availability is not connected.'); } } catch (err) { setError(err.message || 'Unable to search flights. Please try again.'); } finally { setLoading(false); } } function chooseDestination(code) { setDest(code); document.getElementById('flight-search')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); } return (
